observation: The newly exported assert_reentry_uptake_binding_factory_origin() checks only that binding._factory_seal is the module-private _BINDING_SEAL. GwtReentryUptakeBinding declares _factory_seal with dataclasses.field(default=None, ...) and does not set init=False, so the field participates in dataclass __init__. Python dataclasses.replace() copies unchanged init fields from the source object. A valid factory-produced binding can therefore be replaced with changed lineage-bearing public fields while retaining the exact private seal object. __post_init__ validates the changed field shape but does not revalidate WP506/WP507/WP508 source-evidence lineage. A consumer that uses only the new helper can therefore accept a post-factory replacement object as factory-origin lineage evidence.
